verdict: Dayforce: Choose Dayforce when unified HR, continuous-calc payroll, and time/WFM in one enterprise app is the job — not when you need published SMB payroll or a dedicated ATS. Scores use the HR editorial methodology from first-party research as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing.
bestFor: Mid-to-enterprise teams that want HR, pay, and time in one app with continuous payroll calc

notIdealFor: Structured-hiring ATS as the primary purchase (Greenhouse)
Deskless comms hubs without enterprise payroll
tradeoffs: Published free tiers vs paid depth for ATS, WFM, time, or training jobs
Hub / multi-module pricing complexity vs single-product floors
Mobile/frontline readiness vs desk-bound admin depth

recommendation: Choose Dayforce when unified HR, continuous-calc payroll, and time/WFM in one enterprise app is the job — not when you need published SMB payroll or a dedicated ATS. Compare UKG Pro for deeper complex scheduling, Workday for the HCM default, ADP Workforce Now for payroll-compliance mid-market, and Gusto if US SMB payroll is the job.

overallScoreRationale: Weighted average of the nine HR editorial criteria using the category weights (hiring/workforce fit 15, workflow depth 14, ease of use 12, integrations 12, value 12, mobile/frontline 10, scalability 9, analytics 8, AI 8), rounded to 1 decimal. Products are scored inside their job cluster — ATS, core HRIS, payroll/benefits, people-platform, enterprise HCM, frontline WFM, time & attendance, SOP training, and LMS peers are not forced into one undifferentiated ranking. Not a hands-on lab score, and affiliate economics are excluded.
